name: thai-official-academic-writing
title_zh: 泰文公文与论文的排版校对一体机
tagline_zh: 写泰国公文、项目书、论文或APA 7参考文献，自动处理泰文排版与文档格式；机构有模板时，它主动让位不抢活。
tagline_en: Draft, revise, and QA Thai official letters, proposals, theses, and APA 7 refs—with native typography and layout.
desc_en: Draft, revise, and quality-check Thai official correspondence, project proposals, research writing, and APA 7 references, including Thai typography and document layout. Use for หนังสือราชการ, โครงงาน, reports, theses, or academic manuscripts; defer to an institution's required template when supplied.
why_zh: 不只是改语法，它连泰文标点、段落缩进、页面边距都按官方习惯调好；你交模板，它立刻闭嘴照做。
why_en: It doesn't just fix grammar—it aligns Thai punctuation, indents, and margins to official norms, then yields to any supplied.
limit_zh: 只覆盖泰文语境下的公文、项目书、研究写作与APA 7；不处理英文论文、非学术创意写作。
limit_en: Thai-only for official letters, proposals, research writing, and APA 7. No English papers, no creative writing, and it won't invent your.
title_en: Thai official & academic writing, formatted and checked
